IMO0013.name: Arrival/departure code
IMO0013.definition: A code in the message to show whether the information is submitted for the ship arrival or departure.

IMO0063.name: Date and time of arrival - actual
IMO0063.definition: The date and time the ship arrives at a specified location, ATA.

IMO0064.name: Date and time of arrival - estimated
IMO0064.definition: The date and time the ship is estimated to arrive at a specified location, ETA.

IMO0065.name: Date and time of departure - actual
IMO0065.definition: The date and time the ship departs from a specified location, ATD.

IMO0066.name: Date and time of departure - estimated
IMO0066.definition: The date and time the ship is estimated to depart from a specified location, ETD.

IMO0075.name: Last port of call name
IMO0075.definition: The name and country of the port immediately previous to the port of arrival.

IMO0076.name: Last port of call, coded
IMO0076.definition: A code representing the port immediately previous to the port of arrival.

IMO0084.name: Next port of call, coded
IMO0084.definition: The port immediately subsequent to the port of departure.

IMO0085.name: Next port of call name
IMO0085.definition: The name and country of the port immediately subsequent to the port of departure.

IMO0108.name: Port of arrival, coded
IMO0108.definition: A code representing the port where the ship arrives.

IMO0109.name: Port of arrival name
IMO0109.definition: The name and country of the port where the ship arrives.

IMO0111.name: Port of departure, coded
IMO0111.definition: The code representing the port from which the ship departs.

IMO0112.name: Port of departure name
IMO0112.definition: A name and country of the port from which the ship departs.

IMO0126.name: Previous port of call name
IMO0126.definition: The name and country of a previous port of call.

IMO0127.name: Previous port of call, coded
IMO0127.definition: A code representing a previous port of call.

IMO0136.name: Ship call sign
IMO0136.definition: The ship’s identification used primarily for radio communications.

IMO0138.name: Ship flag State, coded
IMO0138.definition: A code representing the nationality of the ship shown on its IMO ship’s certificate.

IMO0139.name: Ship gross tonnage
IMO0139.definition: The gross tonnage shown on the ship's International Tonnage Certificate or other document issued by the flag State or recognized organization.

IMO0140.name: Ship IMO number
IMO0140.definition: The ship identification number shown on its IMO ship’s certificate.

IMO0142.name: Ship name
IMO0142.definition: The ship’s name shown on the IMO ship’s certificates.

IMO0143.name: Ship net tonnage
IMO0143.definition: The net tonnage shown on the ship's International Tonnage Certificate or other document issued by the Flag State or Recognized Organization.

IMO0148.name: Ship registry port name
IMO0148.definition: The name and country for the Port of Registry shown on the IMO ship certificate.

IMO0191.name: Voyage number
IMO0191.definition: An operator-assigned reference code for the ship's voyage.

IMO0233.name: Berth position
IMO0233.definition: A name, number or description used to identify a berth position. A berth position is a specific position within a berth where a vessel may be moored or anchored. (IHO Concept register).

IMO0326.name: Ship MMSI number
IMO0326.definition: The unique radio identification number (ship station identity).

IMO0332.name: Course over ground
IMO0332.definition: The ship current course over ground indicated in the 360 degrees notation from true north.

IMO0333.name: Speed over ground
IMO0333.definition: The ship current speed over ground in decimal knots.

IMO0357.name: Ship draught
IMO0357.definition: Maximum ship present static draught in meters and centimeters.

IMO0360.name: Wind direction
IMO0360.definition: True direction, from where wind is blowing (or will blow), measured in degrees.

IMO0452.name: Total ballast water on board
IMO0452.definition: Total physical measurement of ballast water on board including sediments in cubic metres (m3).

IMO0537.name: Distance to destination
IMO0537.definition: The remaining distance in nautical miles reported by the vessel to a specific destination.

IMO0541.name: Date and time to location in port - estimated
IMO0541.definition: The date and time the ship estimates to reach the specified location in port.

IMO0543.name: Date and time to location in port - planned
IMO0543.definition: The date and time the ship plans to reach the specified location in port.

IMO0544.name: Location in port, latitude
IMO0544.definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of an entity.

IMO0545.name: Location in port, longitude
IMO0545.definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of an entity.

IMO0548.name: Berth, coded
IMO0548.definition: A code used to identify a berth. A berth is defined as a place, generally named or numbered, where a vessel may moor or anchor. (IHO Concept register).

IMO0580.name: Master given name
IMO0580.definition: The given name of the person in charge of the ship.

IMO0597.name: Event type, coded
IMO0597.definition: A code representing the event which triggers the reporting (e.g. Noon Report, Arrival, Departure). Event may vary according to contract.

IMO0598.name: Operation type, coded
IMO0598.definition: A code representing the type of operation being undertaken for the duration of the report (e.g. sailing, in port loading, at anchor).

IMO0600.name: Elapsed time
IMO0600.definition: The duration in hours since previous event report.

IMO0601.name: Ship position when reporting, latitude
IMO0601.definition: The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship at the time of reporting.

IMO0602.name: Ship position when reporting, longitude
IMO0602.definition: The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship at the time of reporting.

IMO0603.name: Ship reporting date time
IMO0603.definition: The date and time when the reporting event occurred.

IMO0605.name: Voyage leg identifier
IMO0605.definition: The identifier used to uniquely describe a leg of a voyage. The identifier can be a reference to features in another electronic dataset such as a route plan.

IMO0613.name: Distance over ground
IMO0613.definition: The distance traveled within the time elapsed, over ground measured in nautical miles.

IMO0615.name: Distance to next port
IMO0615.definition: The remaining sailing distance until next port (over ground), measured in nautical miles.

IMO0617.name: Speed propeller
IMO0617.definition: The average of each propeller(s) speed measured in Revolutions Per Minute (RPM).

IMO0620.name: Ship true heading
IMO0620.definition: The direction in which the ship is pointing with respect to true north, expressed in degrees.

IMO0621.name: Draught forward
IMO0621.definition: The vertical distance in metres between the waterline and the bottom of the hull, with the thickness of the hull included from forward.

IMO0622.name: Draught aft
IMO0622.definition: The vertical distance in metres between the waterline and the bottom of the hull, with the thickness of the hull included from aft.

IMO0625.name: Wind force
IMO0625.definition: Force of wind on Beaufort Scale as measured by onboard ship weather station, over the time of reporting (scale from 0-12).

IMO0626.name: Wind direction, estimated, relative
IMO0626.definition: Best estimate of the direction of wind relative to the ship, measured in degrees, made by the seafarer onboard.

IMO0627.name: Wind direction, estimated, true
IMO0627.definition: Best estimate of the direction of wind, measured in degrees true, made by the seafarer onboard.

IMO0628.name: Air temperature
IMO0628.definition: The measure of air temperature in degrees Celsius at ship location.

IMO0631.name: Sea direction, true
IMO0631.definition: Best estimate of the direction of sea, in degrees true, made by the seafarer onboard.

IMO0632.name: Sea height
IMO0632.definition: Recorded sea height in metres as per weather provider.

IMO0639.name: Fresh water bunkered
IMO0639.definition: Fresh water bunkered onboard, measured in metric tons.

IMO0640.name: Fresh water produced
IMO0640.definition: Fresh water produced onboard by running the Fresh Water Generator, measured in metric tons.

IMO0641.name: Fresh water consumed
IMO0641.definition: Fresh drinking water consumed onboard, measured in metric tons.

IMO0645.name: Fresh water remaining onboard
IMO0645.definition: Fresh drinking water remaining onboard, measured in metric tons.

IMO0666.name: Fuel bunker port, coded
IMO0666.definition: A code representing the port where the fuel is to be bunkered, according to a bunker delivery note.

IMO0667.name: Fuel bunker port, name
IMO0667.definition: The name and country of the port where the fuel is to be bunkered, according to a bunker delivery note.

IMO0670.name: Fuel consumed, by Main Engine
IMO0670.definition: Fuel consumed by Main Engine, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0673.name: Fuel consumed, by Auxiliary Boiler
IMO0673.definition: Fuel consumed by Auxiliary Boiler, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0674.name: Fuel quantity remaining onboard
IMO0674.definition: Remaining fuel onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0676.name: Cylinder lube oil remaining onboard
IMO0676.definition: The cylinder lube oil remaining onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons.

IMO0678.name: Cylinder lube oil, consumption
IMO0678.definition: Lube oil consumption in grams per hour per unit of output measured in kilowatt of the engine (g/kWh).

IMO0758.name: Delivery location name
IMO0758.definition: The name of the exact location of delivery within the port mentioned in the Delivery field (i.e. Anchorages or berths of operations).

IMO0760.name: Ship representative name
IMO0760.definition: The name of the ship representative (Master or Chief Engineer) onboard the receiving vessel responsible for overseeing the

IMO0856.name: Inbound Port jurisdiction, coded
IMO0856.definition: Reporting jurisdiction covering the arriving port for ship voyage. This is used to define the mandatory reporting requirements  related to ship emissions  for different voyages.

IMO0857.name: Outbound Port jurisdiction, coded
IMO0857.definition: Reporting jurisdiction covering the departure port for the ship voyage. This is used to define the mandatory reporting requirements related to ship emissions for different voyages.

IMO0893.name: Fuel consumed, by Auxiliary Engine
IMO0893.definition: Fuel consumed by Auxiliary Engine, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0901.name: Fuel consumed, by Incinerator
IMO0901.definition: Fuel consumed by Incinerator, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0903.name: Fuel consumed, by Other Fuel Consuming Devices
IMO0903.definition: Fuel consumed by Other Fuel Consuming Devices, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0908.name: Fuel consumed by Main Engine, by fuel type
IMO0908.definition: Fuel consumed by Main Engine, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0914.name: Fuel consumed by Auxiliary Boiler, by fuel type
IMO0914.definition: Fuel consumed by Auxiliary Boiler, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0916.name: Fuel consumed by Auxiliary Engine, by fuel type
IMO0916.definition: Fuel consumed by Auxiliary Engine, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0932.name: Fuel consumed by Incinerator, by fuel type
IMO0932.definition: Fuel consumed by Incinerator, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

IMO0936.name: Fuel consumed by Other Fuel Consuming Devices, by fuel type
IMO0936.definition: Fuel consumed by Other Fuel Consuming Devices, measured in metric tons since last reporting.
